audit_scope: Independent interpretation and deterministic accounting audit of the complete frozen REPORT. Protected Monte Carlo endpoints are not regenerated here; their original raw-array replay belongs to the immutable collector audit. No new fit, innovation, confidence event, selection, or numerical-source change.
confirmed_interpretations: At final stage in the unpiloted Long d50 and Intermediate d50 cells, NBO has protected material payoff advantages over both Raw actor and DPO at the original 1e-4 margin. NBO also has a lower actual final construction/query process clock than DPO in these cells.

At final stage, the six non-Long cells establish NBO versus cached-SAA payoff equivalence within +/-1e-4 and a lower actual NBO construction/query clock. Adding the same complete audit bill to both procedures preserves this ordering; this latter total is an explicitly conservative allocation.
Cached SAA is materially better in payoff than NBO in both Long final-stage cells. DPO is better in payoff than NBO in Long d10. All such cases remain in the complete ledger.
The vector predictor and Raw actor have lower actual final construction/query clocks than NBO in every cell. NBO is not the least expensive procedure among all credible representations.
Positive, material, and equivalent classifications are not disjoint. The receipt lists their exact flags for every direct comparison.

Earlier-stage costs are conservative allocations, not separately executed early-stopping experiments. Some earlier cached-SAA candidates are already equivalent at lower allocated work; the final-stage finding does not establish a minimum-work frontier or online work-to-target advantage.
The menu tests complete representation and optimization procedures. It contains no independent critic-MSE estimate or causal identification of the fixed-feature projection mechanism.

The 80 attained scalar bounds cover one fixed query per cell-stream and the whole prescribed one-dimensional finite intervention segment. The other 48 bounds do not certify the margin; they do not establish that true candidate regret exceeds the margin. Full-vector and continuous-time optimality are outside their scope.
population: All 8 calibration-dimension cells, all 3 work stages, 16 fixed equally weighted training streams and 384 fixed equally weighted queries per cell; 512 independent antithetic pairs per query.
